 Glasgow Christmas bin collections: four bank holidays could move your usual day
 The council hadn't published its festive dates by the end of October, and almost 68% of Glasgow homes are flats: here's who may be affected.
 Jon Tyson / Unsplash 
 Save 
 Share 
 Kristina Galvydyte 
  –  
 Staff Writer
  ·  
 November 19, 2026
 Add us as a preferred source 
 Glasgow City Council had not published its Christmas and New Year bin collection changes for 2026-27 when we last checked. However, four bank holidays could move your usual collection day, and the council’s own festive page is where the final dates should appear.
 So, we’ve put everything into one place to help you navigate the bin situation during one of the busiest periods of the year.
 The four dates that can move your bin day
 Glasgow’s collections are often changed around the festive bank holidays. These are the days in play this year:
 Friday 25 December 2026 (Christmas Day)
 Monday 28 December 2026 (Substitute Bank Holiday)
 Friday 1 January 2027 (New Year’s Day)
 Monday 4 January 2027 (Substitute Bank Holiday)
 No revised collection dates, missed-collection rules or extra collections have been confirmed yet for this year. If your bin is normally emptied on one of those days, or the days either side, wait for the council’s calendar before you assume anything.
 Houses, flats and tenements
 Households with kerbside collections are those who will be affected. In the previous festive arrangements, the council told houses with collections due on 25 or 26 December, or 1 or 2 January, to put their bins out on the next normal collection day for that bin . Affected homes also received hand-delivered leaflets with the revised dates. Whether the same system applies this year is not yet to be confirmed.
 What is more, flats and tenements could be affected differently. The council’s festive page has previously said these households may see a change, but that bins will still be collected, possibly on a different day from usual, and the bin hubs remain on the street permanently. That matters in Glasgow, where almost 68% of homes are flats and just over 31% are houses or bungalows, according to the council’s 2024/25 figures.
 Last winter’s plan also said the council would lift excess waste on the next collection day for affected households, and the city convener for neighbourhood services, Councillor Laura Doherty, said the council would stick with the same approach. Treat that as background, not a promise for 2026-27.
 If you have extra rubbish
 Last year’s festive page listed four recycling centres for bulk or excess waste:
 Dawsholm , 75 Dalsholm Road, G20 0TB
 Easter Queenslie , 90 Easter Queenslie Road, G33 4UL
 Polmadie , 425 Polmadie Road, G42 0PJ
 Shieldhall , Renfrew Road, G51 4SA
 In 2025/26 they were open seven days a week, 8am to 6pm (last entry 5.45pm), and closed on Christmas Day and New Year’s Day. As always, confirm this year’s hours before you load the car.
 Where to check your own address
 For now, look at the Glasgow City Council page to check the exact collection days for your address. Until your dates appear, put your bins out as normal and keep an eye out for a leaflet through the door.
